_comment: Which UV layout an actor's head and body have, decided from exact facts and
never from a name. In order: the model path of the head part or skin addon
the actor wears, when it is under a folder in 'paths'; else the first row in
'plugins' whose plugin is loaded; else vanilla for the sex. Layouts: vanilla
or ube for a head; vanillafemale, vanillamale, cbbe, unp or ube for a body.
This file is the whole table: nothing is built into the plugin, so what is
here is what is in force. Earlier rows win. A body or head mod this table
does not know is added as a row. Without this file every actor reads as
vanilla and no overlay card has a figure to draw on.
'figures' are the races an overlay card may draw a texture row on, as
Plugin.esp|hexid: each is judged by this table for its own head and body
layouts, and a row is drawn on the first whose layout is the row's.
Only mods that replace the SHARED vanilla-path body belong in 'plugins':
UBE and COtR keep their meshes under folders of their own and add races
rather than replace the default body, so their 'paths' rows decide, and a
plugin row for them would misjudge every vanilla-race actor.
'shapes' name a body by the geometry names in its mesh -- BodySlide writes
the slider set's target shape into the file, so 'CBBE' is CBBE's body and
'3BA' is 3BA's, whatever plugin is loaded. Every name listed has to be on
the actor's own skin mesh; 'prefix' restricts a row to a folder, for a name
another body shares ('BaseShape' is BHUNP's and UBE's). A matching row
decides the Body condition, and its 'layout' the body's UV layout ahead of
the paths and plugins rows. Earlier rows win. Bodies: vanillafemale,
vanillamale, cbbe, 3ba, unp, bhunp, ube, himbo.
